CFML Language Reference: Functions

Round

Rounds a number to the closest whole number. A number exactly halfway between two integers is rounded up.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Round(number)

Parameters

number
Any number.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

"Up" means toward positive infinity, so Round(2.5) is 3 and Round(-2.5) is -2. To round to two decimal places, use Round(n * 100) / 100, or format the number for display with NumberFormat or DecimalFormat.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>Round(number)</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="3.49,3.5,3.51,-2.5,-2.51">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Round(n)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFSET Price = 19.98765>
<CFOUTPUT><P>#Price# to two places: #Round(Price * 100) / 100#</CFOUTPUT>
